channel.title: Saint Charbel News | marsharbel.com
channel.description: Sourced Saint Charbel news: pilgrimages, feast days, relic visits and newly reported cases, each labeled as formally recognized or reported.

item.title: Pope Leo XIV's lung surgery completed successfully
item.description: Update. Doctors removed the lower lobe of Pope Leo XIV's right lung at Gemelli Hospital. The Holy See says the operation was successful with no complications, and tissue examined during surgery confirmed lung adenocarcinoma. The Pope has returned to his room; post-operative examinations will follow. Source: Pope Leo XIV's lung surgery completed successfully (https://www.vaticannews.va/en/pope/news/2026-10/pope-leo-surgery-gemelli-hospital-successful.html)

item.title: Catholics Pray for Pope Leo at Gemelli
item.description: Archived Rosary announcement. An evening Rosary was held in Gemelli Hospital's chapel on October 13, presided over by Cardinal Baldassarre Reina, according to Catholic News Service reporting published by the USCCB. Churches and religious communities in Rome were also invited to join in prayer. The Holy See later reported that the Pope's operation was completed successfully. Source: Catholics Pray for Pope Leo at Gemelli (https://www.vaticannews.va/en/church/news/2026-10/rosary-gemelli-hospital-prayers-pope-leo-xiv-surgery.html)

item.title: Charbel Premieres in Beirut
item.description: Confirmed. The NMPRO and MTV feature premiered October 9 at Beirut Media Zone; the Lebanese cinema release is planned from October 22. International release and streaming remain unconfirmed. Source: L'Orient-Le Jour: October 12 charity screening for Anta Akhi (October 8, French) (https://www.lorientlejour.com/article/1550058/la-projection-du-film-charbel-au-profit-de-anta-akhi.html)

item.title: Mar Charbel Listed for October 22 Opening in Beirut
item.description: Announcement. Cinemacity Beirut Souks lists October 22 as the opening date; no screening sessions are scheduled yet. Source: Mar Charbel Listed for October 22 Opening in Beirut (./saint-charbel-movie)

item.title: From the Historic Photograph to a New Saint Charbel Art Series
item.description: Update. The gallery pairs the historic photograph with a new AI transformation series, labeled as artistic renditions, not photographs. Source: From the Historic Photograph to a New Saint Charbel Art Series (./gallery)

item.title: Lebanese and Jordanian Ministers Visit Saint Charbel's Pilgrimage Sites
item.description: Report. Lebanon's and Jordan's tourism ministers toured Qozhaya, Bqaa Kafra and Annaya; a visit, not a new agreement or a trail opening. Source: Lebanese and Jordanian Ministers Visit Saint Charbel's Pilgrimage Sites (https://www.nna-leb.gov.lb/en/news/225264/tourism-minister-tours-monastery-of-qozhaya-bqaa-kafra-annaya-with-jordanian-counterpart-2)

item.title: El Paso Parish Announced an October 3-4 Lebanese Festival
item.description: Archived parish announcement, not a post-event report: Saint Sharbel Mission invited El Paso to its Lebanese Festival on October 3 and 4. Source: El Paso Parish Announced an October 3-4 Lebanese Festival (https://stsharbelelpaso.org/)

item.title: Saint Charbel's Formation Monastery Receives Relics from Rome
item.description: Report. Kfifan's Monastery of Saints Cyprian and Justina received relics of its two patron saints from Rome. Source: Saint Charbel's Formation Monastery Receives Relics from Rome (https://www.mtv.com.lb/news/1743007)

item.title: Beirut Cathedral Consecrates an Altar to Blessed Patriarchs Douaihy and Hoayek
item.description: Event. Cardinal Al-Rahi consecrated an altar to Blessed Patriarchs Douaihy and Hoayek at Beirut's Saint George Cathedral. Both remain Blessed, not canonized saints. Source: Beirut Cathedral Consecrates an Altar to Blessed Patriarchs Douaihy and Hoayek (https://nna-leb.gov.lb/en/news/225064/president-aoun-attends-mass-dedicated-to-blessed-patriarchs-douaihy-hoayek-led-by-al-rahi-2)

item.title: Three Priests Martyred at Monte Sole Beatified in Bologna
item.description: Event. Cardinal Semeraro beatified three priests killed in the 1944 Monte Sole massacres; recognized as martyrs, no miracle was required. Source: Three Priests Martyred at Monte Sole Beatified in Bologna (https://www.dehoniani.org/en/the-three-martyrs-of-monte-sole-to-be-beatified-on-september-27/)

item.title: Emmitsburg Celebrates Nine Years of Saint Sharbel's Shrine
item.description: Event. Pilgrims gathered September 26 at the National Shrine Grotto for the shrine's ninth anniversary. Source: Emmitsburg Celebrates Nine Years of Saint Sharbel's Shrine (https://www.familyofsaintsharbel.org/our-news)

item.title: Prayer Walk from Byblos to Annaya for South Lebanon's Christians
item.description: Event. Pilgrims walked some 10 miles from Byblos to the Monastery of Saint Maron in Annaya, carrying the intentions of Christians in the southern border villages. Source: Prayer Walk from Byblos to Annaya for South Lebanon's Christians (https://www.catholicworldreport.com/2026/09/20/lebanese-faithful-to-walk-to-st-charbels-shrine-in-prayer-for-christians-in-countrys-south/)

item.title: Fulton Sheen Beatified in Saint Louis Before 50,000
item.description: Event. Cardinal Tagle presided for Pope Leo XIV as the broadcaster was declared Blessed in Saint Louis; his cause for canonization continues. Source: Fulton Sheen Beatified in Saint Louis Before 50,000 (blessed-fulton-sheen)

item.title: The Doctor Who Investigated a St. Charbel Healing Speaks
item.description: Report. Dr. Anne Borik, who headed the medical committee in the Dafne Gutierrez case, gave a new interview on how it changed her practice of medicine. Source: The Doctor Who Investigated a St. Charbel Healing Speaks (saint-charbel-prayer-for-healing)

item.title: American Priest Walks the St. Charbel Trail
item.description: Event. Father Michael Sliney, LC, completed a pilgrimage along Lebanon's St. Charbel Trail and encouraged more Americans to make the journey. Source: American Priest Walks the St. Charbel Trail (saint-charbel-trail)

item.title: Maronite Patriarch Elias Hoayek Beatified at Dimane
item.description: Event. Patriarch Hoayek (1899-1931) was beatified at Dimane before President Aoun; Pope Leo XIV called him a man of dialogue and hope. Source: Maronite Patriarch Elias Hoayek Beatified at Dimane (https://www.vaticannews.va/en/pope/news/2026-07/pope-leo-angelus-beatification-elias-hoayek-lebanon-prayers.html)

item.title: Hundreds Honor St. Charbel at Revesby Feast
item.description: Event. Hundreds gathered at Revesby, Sydney, for the saint's July feast, one of many annual Maronite parish celebrations. Source: Hundreds Honor St. Charbel at Revesby Feast (https://catholicweekly.com.au/hundreds-honour-st-charbel-at-revesby-feast/)

item.title: St. Charbel's Pilgrim Relic Visits Cebu
item.description: Event. The Archdiocese of Cebu welcomed the pilgrim relic with a Welcome Mass and three days of public veneration across parishes. Source: St. Charbel's Pilgrim Relic Visits Cebu (https://thearchdioceseofcebu.com/st-charbels-relic-visits-cebu-archdiocese/)

item.title: Two New Miracles Reported in Early 2026
item.description: Reported, recorded at Annaya. Two miracles attributed to St. Charbel's intercession were reported early in 2026; Annaya's register now exceeds 29,680 recorded cases. Source: Two New Miracles Reported in Early 2026 (https://www.catholicworldreport.com/2026/01/28/2-new-miracles-reported-through-intercession-of-st-charbel-in-2026/)

item.title: First Papal Visit to Saint Charbel's Tomb
item.description: Event. Pope Leo XIV prayed at the saint's tomb in Annaya during his apostolic journey to Lebanon, the first pope to do so. Source: First Papal Visit to Saint Charbel's Tomb (pope-leo-xiv-annaya-visit)
